name: CreateGroup

parameters.help_en: Application name used by the workspace. Default value: live
parameters.help_zh: 空间使用的应用名称，默认取值：live
parameters.name: app

parameters.help_en: Region where the workspace is located, that is, the service center
parameters.help_zh: 空间所属区域，即服务中心
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
Ingest protocol used by the workspace. Valid values:

gb28181

rtmp
parameters.help_zh:
空间使用的接入协议，取值：
gb28181
rtmp
parameters.name: in_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Playback protocols used by the workspace. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values:

flv

hls

rtmp
parameters.help_zh:
空间使用的播放协议，多值用逗号分隔，取值：
flv
hls
rtmp
parameters.name: out_protocol

parameters.help_en: Ingest domain used by the workspace
parameters.name: push_domain

parameters.help_en: Streaming domain used by the workspace
parameters.name: play_domain

parameters.help_en:
Whether to enable on-demand stream pulling. Valid values:

false (default)

true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用按需拉流。取值：
false（默认）
true
parameters.name: lazy_pull

parameters.help_en: Callback URL triggered when device or stream status updates in the workspace
parameters.help_zh: 空间内设备/流状态更新时的回调
parameters.name: callback

GbId.description_en: National standard ID associated with the workspace. (Applies only to workspaces using national standard ingest.)
GbId.description_zh: 空间关联的国标Id。（仅适用于国标接入的空间）

GbIp.description_en: IP address of the national standard signaling gateway server associated with the workspace. (Applies only to workspaces using national standard ingest.)
GbIp.description_zh: 空间关联的国标信令网关服务器地址。（仅适用于国标接入的空间）

GbPort.description_en: National standard signaling server port provided by the workspace. (Applies only to workspaces using national standard ingest.)
GbPort.description_zh: 空间提供的国标信令服务器端口。（仅适用于国标接入的空间）
